game_split.method: chronological unique-date split; no date overlaps

scores.selection_metric: validation MAE, separately for home and away points
scores.consistency: Total points and winning margin are derived from the same predicted home and away scores.

split.method: chronological unique-date split; no date overlaps

players.model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor; per-minute rates scaled by expected minutes
players.intervals: Empirical 5th/95th validation residual quantiles; coverage is measured on the chronological test set, not guaranteed.
players.availability_note: Predictions do not assert confirmed player availability or lineup status.

backtesting.method: expanding training window; three rolling chronological evaluation windows within the development period; final holdout excluded

team_strength.elo_source: Chronological game scores, updated only after each completed game.
team_strength.net_rating_proxy: Average points scored minus average points conceded when official ratings are absent.

limitations: Processed Parquet is preferred; when absent the training workflow uses the supplied Raw CSVs without modifying them.
Only completed games with positive home and away scores enter game targets.
No player injury, availability, lineup, or confirmed rotation source is available.
Player prediction intervals are empirical validation residual intervals and do not guarantee future coverage.
Team history includes all competitions represented in the source files; game type is not silently restricted.
SHAP is not required; feature importance uses model-native impurity importance or absolute logistic coefficients.
Selected deployment estimators are refit on all historical rows only after the chronological holdout has been evaluated; holdout metrics are preserved and were not used for model selection.

upcoming_schedule_predictions.reason: No future scheduled games matched known historical teams.

seasonal_holdout_metrics.season_assignment: Inferred from game timestamp using an October season boundary; the source Games.csv does not provide a season column.
